Information Election Results Archive Welcome to the hub for Oceana County Elections. Here you’ll be able to find all election related information including election results, upcoming election details, an archive of past election results, and resources on registering and confirming your voter status. The County Clerk’s Office coordinates all Elections conducted in Oceana in compliance with all Michigan and Federal Election Laws. Please direct all election related inquiries to the County Clerks Office: (231) 873-4328 .
